text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Merchant Shipping Citation and !Registration of Government Ships) Regulations, 1988 and shall come commence· into operation on 1st day of October, 1988. ment.

In these Regulations -. Definition. "Act" means the Merchant Shipping Act. Chapter 145. "Government Ship" means and includes a ship, or classes of ships, belonging to the Government but not including ships belonging to the Royal Brunei Armed Forces and the Royal Brunei Police Force.
